passif.description:
Increases basic stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] participating in battle by [FF8000]15%[-], and increases all stats of the hero by [FFAE00]7%[-] for [FFAE00]each[-] Applicable Ally.
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Allies: Demons and [The Seven Deadly Sins][-][/i]


When all allies participating in battle are [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] and the hero is not in [00D5FF]"Assault Mode"[-], the hero gains [00D5FF]Trillion Revenge[-] at the start of the battle and at the end of the allies' turn. The effect is removed at the end of the enemy's turn.[i][C0C0C0]※Trillion Revenge: Immune to Debuff effects.
Immune to Stance Cancel if applied at the start of the battle.
Counters and exacts Vengeance when an ally is attacked.
※Vengeance: Inflicts damage equal to [FFAE00]70%[-] of the initial Max HP.
Additional damage equal to [FFAE00]150%[-] of damage taken.
※"Assault Mode": Attack-related stats [FF8000]+50%[-], damage dealt [FFAE00]+70%[-].
Does not take Reflect or Counter damage.
Grants Immortality and Stat Decrease Immunity.
Removes barrier buffs before unleashing all-target attacks.
(Limit [FF8000]3 times[-])
("Assault Mode" effect is enhanced according to Ultimate Move level)[-][/i]

If there are [FFAE00]2[-] or more surviving [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] while the hero has [00D5FF]Trillion Revenge[-], they are granted a [FF8000]40%[-] [00D5FF]Damage Taken Suppression[-] and their final damage taken decreases by [FFAE00]30%[-].

Grants [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] [00D5FF]Debuff Immunity[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-] at the start of the battle.

When the hero uses a [00D5FF]single-target attack[-], [00D5FF]"Hell Blaze"[-] is applied to up to [FFAE00]1[-] enemy for [FFAE00]3 turns[-]. When the hero uses a skill on an affected enemy, their [00D5FF]Damage Taken Suppression[-] is [00D5FF]halved[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※"Hell Blaze": Damage taken [FFAE00]+70%[-].
Decreases final Recovery Rate by [FFAE00]7%[-] for every [FFAE00]5%[-] of the target's diminished HP.
The hero is immune to "Hell Blaze".[-][/i]

If the hero does not take damage from an enemy skill during the enemy's turn, all enemies are inflicted with the [00D5FF]Shadow Engulfment[-] effect for [FFAE00]1 turn[-]. If the hero does not die from an enemy's Ultimate Move, the Ultimate Move Gauge fills by [FF8000]5 orbs[-] (Limit [FFAE00]once[-]).
[i][C0C0C0]※Shadow Engulfment: All stats [FFAE00]-50%[-].[-][/i]
